theme_strategy.details: Deep Navy (#071A33) serves as the anchor background for high-impact sections (Hero, Manifesto, Footer), instilling trust and stability. Light Gray (#F3F6F9) and White (#FFFFFF) are used for high-density content grids (Why MBtex) to maintain legibility. Accent heavily with Gold (#C9A227) for luxury/wealth and Electric Cyan (#00B8D9) for fintech innovation.

typography.hierarchy_rules: H1 max text-5xl md:text-7xl with tracking-tight. Overlines uppercase tracking-[0.2em] in Cabinet Grotesk. Body loose leading-relaxed in Manrope.
typography.instructions: Use font-light or font-black on headings to create radical contrast. Never default to generic bold.

visual_enhancers.background_pattern: MANDATORY: Create a custom `<GeometricBackground />` component using absolute positioned inline SVG. Draw thin, elegant circular and straight intersecting lines (like topography or high-tech network nodes) covering the Deep Navy background. Use stroke='#C9A227' and stroke='#00B8D9' with 10-15% opacity.
visual_enhancers.hero_animations: Kinetic Hero with masked line-by-line text reveal on load using framer-motion (`overflow-hidden`, `y: 100%` to `y: 0`, staggered). Implement subtle parallax on the hero image/pattern.
visual_enhancers.scroll_effects: Lenis smooth scrolling (MANDATORY). Framer-motion scroll reveals (y: 30, opacity: 0 -> 1) with staggered delays for bento grids.
visual_enhancers.marquee: One slow editorial marquee (using react-fast-marquee). High contrast, elegant spacing (`gap-24` or `gap-32`). Do not make it a fast racecar; make it a slow organic drift.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Sticky headers MUST use Crystal Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#071A33]/70 border-b border-[#C9A227]/20`).
visual_enhancers.icons: Use `@phosphor-icons/react` (Duotone/Light weight) for large section decorative icons. Install using `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`.

layouts.hero: Full height (min-h-screen). Deep Navy background with `<GeometricBackground />`. Massive Cormorant Garamond typography. Floating Gold/Cyan accents.
layouts.why_mbtex: Bento Grid Protocol: 3x2 grid of cards on Light Gray (#F3F6F9) background. Use tight gaps (`gap-6`) and generous internal card padding (`p-8`).
layouts.what_we_do: Numbered manifesto chapters. Vertical stacked sections with massive sticky numbers (text-8xl text-[#C9A227]/20) on the left (col-span-4), content and imagery on the right (col-span-8).
layouts.fintech_tabs: Platform 02 must feature a highly customized Shadcn Tabs component for 'Personal/Business/Merchants/Developers/Institutions'. Use pill-shaped triggers with Gold active state.
layouts.approach: Horizontal scrolling section or staggered vertical timeline using framer-motion.

component_instructions.tabs: Override standard Shadcn tabs. Use pill-shaped triggers. Avoid Vercel-look; match the Old Money Tech aesthetic.
component_instructions.contact_form: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Textarea, Select. Background of form area should be Navy. Inputs should be glassmorphic (`bg-white/5 border-white/10 text-white focus:border-[#C9A227]`). Placeholder contact details: info@mbtexgroup.com, Switzerland.
component_instructions.buttons: Primary buttons: `#1557B0` background with `#FFFFFF` text, subtle hover lift (`-translate-y-1`) and shadow. Secondary/Premium buttons: `#C9A227` border with hover fill.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast standards. White text on Navy is good. Gold on Navy is good. Cyan on Navy is good.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js` if available, or install and configure.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
ALL interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attribute (e.g. `data-testid='hero-cta'`).
Do not use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background is strictly prohibited.
For all .js files, ensure the syntax aligns with modern React standards without TypeScript typings, as this is a JS project.
Always provide GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES applied strictly for a cooperation level, premium website.
